decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 784/RDP/P02 and Design & Access Statement Received 25/11/2010 and 784/RDP/P01 A Received 27/01/2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for B2 (Catering) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 07:00-18:00 Monday to Friday and 09:00-16:00 Saturdays and at no time on Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 4 - The ventilation system when operating at its maximum level shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

Condition : 5 - The extract system hereby approved shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher. The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for a B2 (Catering) use shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the commercial unit and the residential flat above, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of [07:00-18.00 Monday to Friday and 09:00-16.00 Saturdays] nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
description: Part change of use from A2 (Financial & professional services) to B2 (Catering) with the installation of an extraction duct to the north elevation (amended description)
